title: Fortune: Helix console internally projected at $1,200 to $1,800; handheld by holiday 2027, console by holiday 2028; Game Pass a la carte add-ons; more layoff rounds

sources.note: Sebastian Herrera, 20 Oct 12:10 PM ET (16:10Z); first report; GamesRadar, Kotaku, The Verge rewrites from 18:42Z

claims.text: Helix internally projected at $1,200 to $1,800 unless Microsoft subsidizes
next-gen handheld by holiday 2027; next console by holiday 2028
Game Pass overhaul: a la carte add-ons for console-only games, cloud, multiplayer, tiered
1,868 cut so far of 3,200; next rounds this month, November, January; plans can change
